## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` and the build output is committed
- [ ] `npm test` passes (contrast, lint, keyboard, RTL, forced colors, axe)
- [ ] `npm run test:visual` passes, or baselines were updated on purpose (`--update`) and the diff is explained here
- [ ] Component metadata (`*.meta.js`) updated: classes, example, a11y notes, v5 migration
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry under the next version
